collectible.title: Hakurei Yin-Yang Orb
collectible.subtitle: The Hakurei Shrine’s Greatest Treasure
collectible.text: Not the real thing, of course, Reimu needs that to fight youkai. Rather, it’s a replica Reimu created with the intention of selling as a souvenir. Not a single one was bought, so she’s giving it to you for free. Be grateful.

collectible.title: Monika’s Book
collectible.subtitle: A surprisingly saucy book lent by Monika
collectible.text:
Reimu and I really enjoyed reading this book together. Too bad we couldn’t finish it before the game ended, but that makes for a fine excuse for us to meet up later, doesn’t it? Ahaha~
It’s such a good book to curl up with— won’t you join us?
collectible.unlock: Complete a game where Reimu and Monika have time to snuggle up with a book after finishing (both must be in their default outfits and Monika can’t be tied up with Sayori)
